## Publication checks

- [ ] Source is public and I have the right to share all text, code and data.
- [ ] No personal identifying details, private wallet-owner dossiers, confidential datasets, keys or recovery data.
- [ ] No claim of fraud, manipulation, common operator or privileged MEV without independent evidence and review.
- [ ] No target harassment, live exploitation, signing, trading or market coordination.
- [ ] The report concerns a bounded public problem and states what remains unverified.

Please consult [community evidence methods](https://github.com/Footloose9/hyperfabric-evolution/blob/main/docs/THREAT_RESEARCH.md). Sensitive security bugs should be reported privately instead of here.
